_about: Image credits for matisse-walk.github.io. All files fetched from Wikimedia Commons on 2026-10-16 via Special:FilePath?width=1600, converted to JPEG q85, max 1600 px. 'licence' records the exact licence template(s) found in the Commons file-page wikitext (and the API LicenseShortName). Public-domain status is EU (life + 70) unless noted; Matisse (d. 1954) is PD in the EU since 1 Jan 2025 but not in the US for works first published after 1930. Moral rights are perpetual in France: always credit the artist and do not crop or distort degradingly.

skipped.reason: Not on Wikimedia Commons. Searches ('Matisse Jazz 1947', 'Matisse Jazz Icarus', 'Icare Matisse') return only a 1947 Rio exhibition poster 'd'après Henri Matisse' (BnF btv1b9005258r) and a museum-installation photo (MatisseJazzVoorlinden.jpg), neither of which is the plate itself. Jazz (1947) is also still in copyright in the US.
Not on Wikimedia Commons ('Matisse Bateau' / 'Matisse Le Bateau 1953' return nothing relevant). Post-1930 work, so not PD in the US either.

No Agence Rol or Agence Meurisse photograph of Henri Matisse exists on Commons (the only Meurisse hit is the painter Auguste Matisse, btv1b9030898m). Two anonymous photos were saved instead (matisse-photo-1898, matisse-photo-1918-cagnes). Rejected named-photographer candidates: Alvin Langdon Coburn 1913 (d. 1966, PD-US only), Edward Steichen 1909 (d. 1973), Carl Van Vechten 1933 (d. 1964, PD-Van Vechten is a US-only release); BnF Ballets russes photos of 1919/1939 (btv1b70022162, btv1b70022414) have no photographer named by the BnF and carry PD-US-expired / PD-France tags only, so they were skipped as unsure.
